/* AppHome01Mapper.selectTodaySchedule */ SELECT S.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS scheduleStart , S.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS scheduleEnd , S.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS secScheduleStart , S.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS secScheduleEnd FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN P INNER JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT S ON ( S.CMPNY_CD = P.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = P.SITE_CD AND S.SCH_CD = P.WORK_PLAN_CD ) WHERE 1=1 AND P.CMPNY_CD = #{ param.cmpnyCd } AND P.SITE_CD = #{ param.siteCd } AND P.USER_CD = #{ param.userCd } AND P.WORK_YMD = #{ param.todayYmd }
ORDER BY (S.APPLY_DATE <= #{ param.todayYmd }) DESC , CASE WHEN S.APPLY_DATE <= #{ param.todayYmd } THEN S.APPLY_DATE END DESC , S.APPLY_DATE ASC LIMIT 1

/* AppHome01Mapper.selectScheduleEndForOvernight */ SELECT S.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS fstSchStrTime , S.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS fstSchEndTime , S.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS secSchStrTime , S.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS secSchEndTime FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN P INNER JOIN TB_SCH_MGMT S ON ( S.CMPNY_CD = P.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = P.SITE_CD AND S.SCH_CD = P.WORK_PLAN_CD ) WHERE 1=1 AND P.CMPNY_CD = #{ param.cmpnyCd } AND P.SITE_CD = #{ param.siteCd } AND P.USER_CD = #{ param.userCd } AND P.WORK_YMD = #{ prevYmd }
ORDER BY (S.APPLY_DATE <= #{ prevYmd }) DESC , CASE WHEN S.APPLY_DATE <= #{ prevYmd } THEN S.APPLY_DATE END DESC , S.APPLY_DATE ASC LIMIT 1

/* AppHome01Mapper.selectLeaveSummary */ SELECT SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS) AS grantedDays , SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS - G.USED_DAYS) AS remainingDays FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE 1=1 AND G.CMPNY_CD = #{ param.cmpnyCd } AND G.USER_CD = #{ param.userCd } AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.EXPIRE_YN = 'N' AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND NOT (G.GRANT_REASON LIKE '[가불]%' AND G.AVAIL_FROM_DATE > #{ param.todayYmd })

/* AppHome01Mapper.selectTodayTbm */ SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.STATUS_CD AS sessionStatus , DATE_FORMAT(S.OPENED_AT, '%H%i') AS openedTime , S.TITLE AS title , M.USER_NM AS presenterName , DATE_FORMAT(ATT.ENTRY_AT, '%H%i') AS myEntryTime , CASE WHEN ATT.EXIT_AT IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS exitExists , ATT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD AS completionStatusCd , ATT.ATTENDANCE_CD AS attendanceCd FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S LEFT JOIN TB_USER M ON ( M.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND M.USER_CD = S.MANAGER_USER_CD ) LEFT JOIN TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE ATT ON ( ATT.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND ATT.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD AND ATT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' AND ATT.USER_CD = #{ param.userCd } AND ATT.DEL_YN = 'N' ) WHERE 1=1 AND S.CMPNY_CD = #{ param.cmpnyCd } AND S.SITE_CD = #{ param.siteCd } AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.STATUS_CD IN ('OPENED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED') AND DATE_FORMAT(S.OPENED_AT, '%Y%m%d') = #{ param.todayYmd } ORDER BY S.OPENED_AT DESC LIMIT 1
